title: verbascum × mirabile
intro: Verbascum × mirabile, commonly known as the 'Miracle of the Andes' or 'Mirabilis', is a hybrid plant that belongs to the Verascum genus, known for its remarkable healing properties. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, wounds, and skin irritations, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Verbascum × mirabile include soothing and calming effects, making it useful in treating anxiety, stress, and insomnia. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its healing and protective properties.
